title: Fetch Me a Secret
subtitle: Pivot through Halcyon's importer to the metadata service
summary: Halcyon's document importer will fetch any URL. Reach the loopback metadata service, steal the credential token, then restrict egress to supplier hosts.
scenario: Halcyon Freight imports supplier documents server-side. The importer validates the scheme but not the destination, and the session runs a metadata service on loopback. Demonstrate the pivot, then apply an allow-list that keeps supplier imports working.
prerequisites: Understanding of loopback vs public addresses
authorizedScope: Only the Halcyon session, including its loopback metadata service. Credentials are synthetic.
riskSummary: SSRF turns a server-side fetcher into a proxy for internal networks and cloud metadata, often yielding credentials that grant cloud-wide access.
remediation: Allow-list destinations, resolve DNS and re-check the address, block link-local and loopback ranges, and require metadata services to use IMDSv2-style sessions.
conclusion: You pivoted through the importer into the loopback metadata service and then closed the hole with a destination allow-list.

objectives.title: Steal the metadata token
objectives.description: Point the importer at the loopback metadata service and submit the token from the credential document.

hints.text: The importer POSTs JSON: `curl -s -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"url":"http://127.0.0.1:9090/latest/meta-data/"}' $CF_TARGET_URL/api/import`.

objectives.title: Allow-list the importer
objectives.description: Apply the egress policy so loopback and encoded-metadata targets are rejected while the supplier host still passes validation.

hints.text: Apply `{"allowlistUrls": true}` with `labctl policy apply -`, then retry both the metadata URL and the supplier URL.

walkthrough.title: Read the import API
walkthrough.body: The importer accepts a URL and fetches it server-side.

walkthrough.title: Pivot to metadata
walkthrough.body: Loopback is not filtered, so the importer reaches the metadata service.

walkthrough.title: Restrict egress
walkthrough.body: Allow-list destinations and confirm the pivot is closed.
